news.title: MD & Director recently sold ₹8.5m worth of stock
news.body: On the 13th of February, Ranjan Jain sold around 160k shares on-market at roughly ₹52.87 per share. This transaction amounted to 5.3% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest sale by an insider in the last 3 months. Ranjan has been a net seller over the last 12 months, reducing personal holdings by ₹12m.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.96 (vs ₹0.13 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.96 (up from ₹0.13 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.62b (up 77% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹41.7m (up ₹36.7m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.6% (up from 0.6% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 40% per year but the company’s share price has remained flat, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.44 (vs ₹0.16 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.44 (up from ₹0.16 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.18b (up 118% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹19.0m (up ₹25.4m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.6% (up from net loss in 2Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 61% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 8% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
